DIRECTLY MEASURED by pokemon-infomation.com across 2,000 aggregated boxes: 3 AR guaranteed/box; 1 Mega Attack Rare guaranteed/box; 1 Trainer SR guaranteed/box plus ~10% for a Pokemon SR (1.10 SR total); SAR ~40%/box; MUR ~2%/box.
